name: Priya Narayanan
player_statement:
A complete player, Priya Narayanan has made a big mark in cricket. With 45 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 23, with an average of 8.27 and a quick strike rate of 88.70. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 18 sixes and 13 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 59.1 overs, taking 28 wickets at an economy rate of 3.74. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
